ai_positioning.summary: DigitalOcean explicitly positions AI/ML as central to its strategy. The company has redefined itself as an agentic inference cloud platform combining production-ready GPU infrastructure, complete cloud stack, model-first inference workflows and agentic experience layer. The portfolio includes DigitalOcean Gradient AI Agentic Cloud with GPU Droplets, Bare Metal GPUs, Large Language Models and AI/ML platform services.
evidence: Overview identifies company as 'agentic inference cloud platform'
Explicit AI/ML offerings: GPU infrastructure, LLMs, Gradient AI Platform
Use cases: 'integrating AI into their businesses, and building AI products and applications'
GPU and ML infrastructure mentioned as priority investments
